title: Minute-scale training for microrobot navigation
title_zh: 分钟级训练用于微型机器人导航
abstract: Microrobots hold considerable potential for various applications in which targeted navigation is a basic requirement. Deep reinforcement learning has recently emerged as a powerful paradigm for fully autonomous microrobot navigation. Yet, current deep reinforcement learning-based approaches pay limited attention to learning efficiency and effectiveness, requiring hours to days for model training. Consequently, this impedes both rapid practical deployment and parameter optimization. To address these challenges, we present a learning framework that enables effective microrobot navigation policies to be trained within minutes. Here in the proposed framework, we develop a fully vectorized simulator with more than 10,000 artificial vascular environments, parallelizing dynamics, ray-casting-based visual feature extraction and feasibility checks across thousands of environments to achieve roughly 190,000 transitions per second. To achieve effectiveness in the fast training, we propose a task-shaping-regularization reward framework. The task-shaping-regularization framework accelerates convergence, improves final performance, reduces action variation by at least 33.7% and increases obstacle clearance by at least 2.1% across all evaluated scenarios. Results show that the proposed learning framework reduces training time to under 10 minutes, while supporting zero-shot deployment across distinct microrobot types and navigation scenarios. Collectively, this framework can substantially shorten the design loop and accelerate the deployment of autonomous microrobots. A vectorized simulator and structured reward framework enable microrobot navigation policies to be trained within minutes and transferred without retraining across robots and environments.
abstract_zh: 微型机器人在各类应用中具有巨大潜力，其中精准导航是基本需求。深度强化学习最近作为全自主微型机器人导航的有力范式崛起。然而，目前基于深度强化学习的方法对学习效率和效果关注有限，需要数小时到数天进行模型训练。因此，这阻碍了快速实际部署和参数优化。为了解决这些挑战，我们提出了一个能够在几分钟内训练有效微型机器人导航策略的学习框架。在所提出的框架中，我们开发了一个完全向量化的模拟器，包含超过10,000个人工血管环境，并将动力学、基于光线投射的视觉特征提取以及可行性检查并行化至数千个环境，以实现每秒约190,000次过渡。为了在快速训练中实现有效性，我们提出了一种任务塑造-正则化奖励框架。任务塑造-正则化框架加速收敛，提高最终性能，至少将动作变异降低33.7%，并在所有评估场景中至少将障碍物通过率提高2.1%。结果表明，所提出的学习框架将训练时间缩短至10分钟以内，并支持跨不同微型机器人类型和导航场景的零-shot部署。综合而言，该框架可以显著缩短设计循环，加速自主微型机器人的部署。向量化模拟器和结构化奖励框架使得微型机器人导航策略能够在几分钟内训练，并无需重新训练即可跨机器人和环境迁移。
